title: MEMORY_VERBS v1 error envelope
description: internal/server/memory.VerbError -- the uniform error envelope MEMORY_VERBS v1's five verbs return in place of their own success response type whenever a call fails at the protocol layer (upstream-verbs.ts ERROR_SCHEMA, RFC 0001 section 8.1). suggestion is always populated.

error.description: Versioned enumerated error code (upstream-verbs.ts ERROR_SCHEMA, with keyed-recovery extension). budget_unsatisfiable is schema-listed but reserved -- this server never emits it.

suggestion.description: Populated on every verb error: problem + cause + fix.
